source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-52

procedures.title: Wiper relay switch-latch and terminal board: install (Type C depressed park wiper)
steps: Fit the gear box cover and washer pump to the wiper, making sure the ground strap is connected (see figure 70 in the manual).
notes: Caution: route the leads so they cannot be pinched between relay and wiper housing.

procedures.title: Wiper drive gear: disassemble (Type C depressed park wiper)
steps: Remove, in order, the crank arm nut, crank arm, rubber seal cap, retaining ring, shim washers, shield and spacer washer.
Slide the gear assembly out of the housing (see figure 80 in the manual).
Slide the drive plate and shaft out of the gear and remove the drive pawl, lock pawl and coil spring as needed.
notes: If the gear is not in park, it can come out without disturbing the relay switch or terminal board.

procedures.title: Wiper drive gear: assemble (Type C depressed park wiper)
steps: Place the drive pawl on the drive plate as in figure 81 in the manual.
Lay the lock pawl over the drive pawl as in figure 81.
Slide the gear and tube over the drive shaft (see figure 82 in the manual), moving the pawls so their pins enter the gear guide channel (see figure 83).
